# SpeakLife

> SpeakLife is a Christian declaration app for speaking Scripture over anxiety, fear, and life's storms. Its one mechanic is "Reject the Lie. Declare the Truth." (2 Corinthians 10:5): each day you speak a verse-rooted declaration out loud instead of only reading about God's Word. iPhone and iPad (iOS 17+), rated 4.9 stars on the App Store from 1,500+ ratings.

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/speaklife-pray-like-jesus/id1617492998
- Category: Health & Fitness
- Price: free to download, 7-day free trial, then $12/month or $49/year
- Features: daily declarations tied to a specific verse, Bible Chat (Scripture-rooted answers), audio devotionals, seven-day Daily Burst plans, 50 life categories, Warrior Room (believers declaring together), Personal Library, streaks, widgets and reminders

- [Home](https://www.speaklifebibleaffirmations.com/): what SpeakLife is and how the daily practice works
